When the magazine has at least 1 round loaded, Glaive Melee Attacks deal 50% increased damage and apply <stasis/>40 Slow for <pve 4 /> <pvp [1.5] /> seconds (<pve 8 /> <pvp [1.5] /> with <stasis/>Whisper of Durance). 

<link Bosses [#CombatantClassifications] /> only receive 20% increased damage.
